decisions.reason: The existing message-510 MODIFY already records flexible prototype dimensions and the top-or-side connector placement policy; vertical orientation was established earlier, so no addition or edit is required.

The existing message-510 MODIFY already records adjustable prototype dimensions and the top-or-side connector placement policy; vertical orientation was established earlier, so no addition or edit is required.
The general access preference does not explicitly supersede the battery connector's specific placement on the back opposite USB-C or its existing clearance constraints.
The source changes mechanical orientation and connector accessibility, not the electrical connector types, pinouts, or interboard power topology.
Mechanical placement and access preferences do not change component availability, sourcing, or cost policies.
The source does not change the required sensor connector inventory, connector types, pinouts, or connector count; placement is already owned by the sensor-board mechanical-layout Requirement.
Board orientation and connector access do not change the standalone regulator, its capacity, activation condition, or power-source selection.
The mechanical-layout decision does not alter the AXP2101 USB, battery, VMID, or VSYS electrical power path.
The source does not change the panel power button's board assignment, connector type, signal connection, or control behavior; general connector placement remains a mechanical-layout concern.
The source does not change the monitored rails, monitoring IC, channel allocation, measurement coverage, or electrical monitor position.
The mechanical orientation and connector-access decision does not alter DCDC1 voltage configuration or regulation requirements.
The source does not change the panel input assignments, GPIO mappings, or requirement that panel controls connect through board connectors.
